question: For each publication year, list the year, the total number of reserved materials, the average length of their titles, distinct number of status, and number of courses, sorted by publication year in descending order.

    COUNT(d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials,

    COUNT(DISTINCT s.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_status_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.SUBJECT_ID) AS number_of_courses

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 20) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, ROUND(ic.total_reserved_materials / NULLIF(cs.max_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS cs ON ic.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC

WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(reserved_count) AS avg_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso LEFT JOIN (SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) AS reserves ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = reserves.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND NOT tso.TERM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, num_chemistry_courses, avg_reserved_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, department_name AS dept, SUM(num_chemistry_courses) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(avg_reserved_materials) AS avg_reserved_materials, MAX(OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS offer_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, department_name, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.offer_dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT department_name, material_status_description, material_count FROM (SELECT department_name, material_status_description, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_name ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 10 AND department_name IN (SELECT department_name FROM (SELECT department_name, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name) AS dept_totals WHERE total_materials > (SELECT AVG(total_materials) FROM (SELECT department_name, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name) AS all_depts)) ORDER BY department_name, material_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code

THEN NULL ELSE COURSE END AS COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE
